Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of its Peabody and Emmy Award-winning mindfulness program 《Stillwater》. Check out the video below now.

《Stillwater》will return on August 21

Apple TV officially announced the premiere date of the fifth season of 《Stillwater》a few days ago, with all five episodes launching simultaneously on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of 《Stillwater》will add more 'breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday habits', continuing the show's longstanding mission of helping children and parents find inner peace.

《Stillwater》originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since won the Daytime Emmy Award for 'Outstanding Editing in a Preschool Animated Program' and the Peabody Award in the 'Children's/Youth' category.

Below is Apple TV's official introduction to the story background of 《Stillwater》, which is adapted from Jon J Muth's bestselling 《Zen》 picture book series published by Scholastic:

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, and you can also subscribe via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a host of popular series and films, including 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》, and 《Silo》.
